title: PerContra decision and release contract v1
description: Append-only records. A decision is a human answer to a mapping gap; each edit is a new version, never an overwrite. A release is an approval of one batch bound to the exact decision versions and mapping snapshot it was checked against.

decision_id.description: Stable per gap: sha256 over (source gl_account, source trans_type, GL file_digest).

gap.description: The unresolved source pair this decision answers, as in the Mapping Gaps sheet.

proposed_target.description: What the workbook proposed, if anything. Shown as a suggestion, never applied silently.

corvus_ref.description: The Corvus CoA row proving the target exists.

author.description: Named person acting in the accountant role. The demo reviewer is labelled as such, never as the original administrator.

supersedes.description: Previous version number, null for version 1. Reverting to an old target creates a new version; it never resurrects an old approval.

state.description: draft: has needs_decision or blocked postings. approved: may be exported as approved. stale: a bound decision has a newer version; export as approved is refused. revoked: a human withdrew it.

mapping_snapshot_digest.description: sha256 over all MappingRefs in the batch, so a changed crosswalk upload also stales the release.

state_reason.description: e.g. 'decision 3f9c… moved from v1 to v2'.

Export.description: A generated loader file. Labelled by what it is, never by what happened next: 'Exported; destination not checked'.
